[92:1] By the night as it covers. [92:2] The day as it reveals.
There are many, many verses which refer to day, night, forenoon, and dawn.
The night is created for our rest and therefore is a benefit.
And we can use that as an analogy to this life because we're blocked from being in God's presence while we're in this life.
It is a sort of darkness. It is a sort of barrier.
We cannot stand God's presence in our present form.
[92:2]  The day as it reveals.
Most of the references in Quran about day are about the Day of Resurrection all the way through.
And I thought of that as an analogy to life which reveals the truth and things as they are.
And I thought that appropriate too, when we consider the Day of Resurrection, the Day of Judgment,
because that's, in fact, what will happen.
We're all familiar with this night and how black it can be without any stars or the moon out.
I used to live up on a hill in the middle of the country and there was no electricity from house to house.
There's nothing to see except the lightning bugs if you were fortunate.
You couldn't see your hand in front of your face.
It was that dark.
And that's quite a cover.
It removes our world from us so that what we remember of the world in the daylight really is an illusion.
The night takes everything away and that's what happened to us when we had to come to this life.
We had to be away from our real life for the period of time we're here.
And when the sun comes up and things begin to take shape, the first thing that we see is silhouettes usually.
I live across the street from a park now and when the sun rises, the trees don't have any texture or depth of color.
They're shapes as the sun begins to come up.
And they look flat.
And as the sun rises further, the color appears and then its depth and texture and you see individual leaves moving and all the parts that make up the tree.
And so the day is revelation and the Day of Judgment is a revelation to all of us,
even those of us who hope to be safe on the Day of Resurrection.
I think we will also see things that we did not see ever in this lifetime.
[92:3] And Him who created the male and the female. [92:4] Your works are of various kinds.

whether it was about creation or about our nature and our characters.

that are not real positive. We're hasty, we're unappreciative, contentious, parsimonious,
and unappreciative is throughout quite a bit.
And there are rare instances where the verse might finish with the phrase "except for those who lead a righteous life" or something similar.
Our works are of various kinds. And for those of us who do things that appear to be Quranic but we are still involved in idol worship,
we know that those works are nullified. And in fact, God designs those works to help others.
We are all in the service of each other but that on the Day of Resurrection, if we are involved in idol worship, they will be as if we had not done them.
Verses 5 through 11 describe two types of people.
God alone knows what each of our choice was,
what in our hearts we really believe even though we forgot when we came here.
For those of us who chose God alone, God willing all of us, God will give us everything in our life to augment that choice.
We know those things as tests.
We know them as gifts. We know them as miracles. We each have stories to tell.
And as we recognize them as such, they augment and cement and increase our faith and our knowledge in God's truth and His guarantees.
For those who do not believe, God also provides for them what they need to continue disbelief.
It may appear as though they're wondrous things for instance they're very wealthy or people
that have great status or people that seem to have a lot of power and can get people
in countries to do things for themselves, for instance.
Those people may consider themselves blessed, but God is merely continuing to test them
so that at the end, at the Day of Judgment, there will be no excuse whatsoever.
Nothing they can say or do except to ask to come back and try again which, of course, we know will not be allowed.
So, I read those verses as descriptions of how God is so Merciful to all of us
because even though God knows the choice of the disbelievers and augments that choice in their life,
He still is providing proof of God alone and the truth to them
in the midst of all the things that are given and all the things that seem to be provided so easily.

for all of us, believers or not, and we have to keep striving to find the truth to be believers with certainty and that's very difficult.
Sometimes some of the things that God causes to happen in our lives,
the people we meet, the settings we find ourselves in are confusing and they can make us wonder if we're on the right path at all.
But that is in fact the test that we have to keep striving and stay
right where we're going toward God alone and whatever is puzzling will become clear very quickly if we do that.
